description: Survey a codebase with no product docs: index it, check an evidence-backed analysis and backlog, and capture golden outputs for parity.

backlog.description: Backlog draft to check (JSON: Goal, Initiatives, Features, Stories, Bugs, and do-not-carry Decisions) against the work-item schema, the survey draft, and its compatibility contract; renders backlog.md and its review digest.

bin.description: With --golden, --parity, or --compat: the program the cases run as {bin}.

budget.description: Module size in tokens (about four bytes each) when grouping files; default 20000.

check-bin.description: With --probe: a sanitiser, checker, or differently optimised build of the legacy program; cases whose stderr carries a checker report, or whose stdout or exit code differs from the capture, are recorded.

compat.description: A legacy test suite as cases (JSON, each test with its suite and area) to run against the new build (--bin) after --golden ran it on the legacy build: scores passes per area, appends to compat-history.jsonl, exit 3 when a test the legacy build passes fails.

coverage.description: With --probe: an lcov tracefile from running the cases under coverage; records the index's functions the cases never reach.

create.description: With --backlog: file the reviewed backlog as issues through the actions log, skipping items already filed; needs --reviewed.

draft.description: Survey draft to check (JSON: claims at the engineering, capability, and product levels, trap findings, the do-not-carry list, the compatibility contract, unknowns, answers, modernisation path): every claim cites the index or a probe, or is marked unknown; renders SURVEY.md.

golden.description: Characterisation cases (JSON) to run against the legacy build (--bin), writing each case's stdout, stderr, and exit code with SHA-256 under golden/.

limit.description: With --create: the most issues one run files; default 25.

module.description: Print one module's fact pack (files, targets, entry points, surfaces, markers, symbols, calls in and out) from the index; read-only.

out.description: Directory for the survey's files (index.json, SURVEY.md, backlog.md, golden/); default .aayudha/survey under the surveyed checkout.

parity.description: Characterisation cases (JSON) to replay against the new build (--bin) and compare with the golden outputs; exit 3 on any difference.

path.description: Checkout to survey; default the repository root.

probe.description: With --golden --bin --run: also run each case twice and under a changed time zone, locale, and HOME (and under strace when installed), writing non-determinism, environment dependencies, and files read and written to probes.json.

reviewed.description: With --create: the review digest of the exact backlog the person reviewed (printed by --backlog).

run.description: With --golden, --parity, or --compat: run the cases' program; without it the cases file is only checked.

shadow.description: With --golden --bin <legacy> --run: the new program, run beside the legacy one on the same inputs; reports every difference without golden files, exit 3 on any.

title: survey
